corpoNonValido: The request body must be a JSON object
tipoAccountNonValido: The account type must be UTENTE or PERSONAL_TRAINER
immagineNonValida: The profile picture must be text (the encoded image) or null
dataNascitaNonValida: The date of birth must be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to today
genereNonValido: The gender must be text of at most 50 characters
pesoNonValido: The weight must be a number of kilograms from 0 to 1000
altezzaNonValida: The height must be a number of centimetres from 0 to 300
obiettivoNonValido: The fitness goal must be text of at most 100 characters
preferenzeNonValide: The visibility preferences must be an object of true/false choices
gamificationNonValida: The gamification setting must be true or false
consensoNonValido: The consent must be true or false
bioOnboardingNonValida: The bio must be text of at most 300 characters
specializzazioniNonValide: The specialisations must be a list of short texts
anniEsperienzaNonValidi: The years of experience must be a whole number from 0 to 100
certificazioniNonValide: The certifications must be text of at most 300 characters
contattoNonValido: The public contact must be text of at most 500 characters
tariffaNonValida: The indicative rate must be text of at most 500 characters
nomeNonValido: The name must be text of 1 to 100 characters
palestraNonValida: The gym must be the id of a gym
ruoloNonValido: The role must be one of UTENTE, PERSONAL_TRAINER or SUPERADMIN
statoNonValido: The status must be one of IN_ATTESA, ATTIVO or BANNATO
paginaNonValida: The page must be a whole number from 1 to 1000000
limiteNonValido: The page size must be a whole number from 1 to 1000
ricercaNonValida: The search must be a single text
